_how: Run Good Life posts one video per break on its second YouTube channel, youtube.com/@rungoodbreaks (Daniel, Nov 26, 2026). Add a page id with its video id and the video title. A page listed here shows that video in place of the night marathon stream; pages not listed keep the stream. For a breaker who streams a whole night in one video, add "kind": "stream" and "start": "1:23:45" (the time the break begins; hours:minutes:seconds, minutes:seconds, or seconds). The page then opens the stream at that moment and its Watch on YouTube link jumps to the same spot. Then run python3 build/breaks/build.py.
